title: Microsoft Teams: decline an incoming mobile call with a message
summary: The briefing matches Microsoft's roadmap and tenant notice, including the planned rollout, automatic availability and call-type restrictions. The corrected admin path and PowerShell control are documented; no feature-specific switch or separate licensing terms were found.

claims.claim: Users will be able to decline an incoming Teams call and send a message to the caller at the same time.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams mobile users will be able to decline an incoming Teams call and send a message to the caller at the same time.

claims.claim: A new Message option appears on the incoming call screen.
claims.quote: Users will see a new Message option on the incoming call screen.

claims.claim: Message offers a predefined response or a Custom option.
claims.quote: From the incoming call screen, users can select Message and choose a predefined response or select Custom to compose a personalized response in the relevant Teams chat.

claims.claim: The notice gives Can I call you later? as a predefined response.
claims.quote: Users can choose a predefined response, such as “Can I call you later?”, “I’m on my way.”, or “Sorry, I can’t talk right now.”

claims.claim: The Teams admin center path is Voice > Calling policies > policy > Edit > Make private calls.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Microsoft Teams admin center, select Voice > Calling policies. Select the policy or policies that you want to modify, and then select Edit. ... Make private calls - This setting controls all calling capabilities in Teams.

claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell supports Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowPrivateCalling $false to disable calling for that policy.
claims.quote: PS C:\> Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowPrivateCalling $true ... -AllowPrivateCalling ... Controls all calling capabilities in Teams. Turning this off will turn off all calling functionality in Teams. ... Type: | Boolean

claims.where: controls[0].governs, controls[0].note; Governance controls; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Make private calls controls all Teams calling functionality, rather than only the decline-with-message option.
claims.quote: Make private calls - This setting controls all calling capabilities in Teams. Turn this setting off to turn off all calling functionality in Teams.

claims.claim: Users with Make private calls turned off cannot see the Calls app.
claims.quote: If the Make private calls setting is turned off in the calling policy, users with that policy can't see the Calls app in their Teams client, can't escalate Chat conversations to audio calls, and can't receive incoming calls.

claims.claim: Users with Make private calls turned off cannot escalate chat conversations to audio calls.
claims.quote: If the Make private calls setting is turned off in the calling policy, users with that policy can't see the Calls app in their Teams client, can't escalate Chat conversations to audio calls, and can't receive incoming calls.

claims.claim: Turning Make private calls off stops incoming calls for affected users, removing the incoming-call opportunity to use Message.
claims.quote: If the Make private calls setting is turned off in the calling policy, users with that policy can't see the Calls app in their Teams client, can't escalate Chat conversations to audio calls, and can't receive incoming calls.

claims.claim: Calling policies can be assigned to users, including through individual, batch or group assignment where supported.
claims.quote: You can assign a policy directly to users, either individually or at scale through a batch assignment (if supported for the policy type), or to a group that the users are members of (if supported for the policy type).

claims.claim: No dedicated admin UI switch or API parameter for disabling only mobile decline-with-message is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams" "decline" "message" mobile admin disable calling policy PowerShell. Opened Calling policies in Teams and Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy, including its syntax and parameter-name search; neither documents this switch.

claims.claim: No Microsoft Learn page dedicated to this feature was found at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams" "decline" "message" "mobile"; Teams mobile decline call message predefined Custom calling policy disable PowerShell licensing price 577176. Opened calling overview and calling policy references; no feature-specific Learn page found.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions

claims.quote: Searched: Teams decline incoming call message mobile retention compliance predefined responses customize minimum version permissions. Read all of MC1540349, particularly Compliance considerations; it requests review but gives no differential treatment.

claims.claim: The notice does not describe a new identity for the feature.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams decline incoming call message mobile retention compliance predefined responses customize minimum version permissions. Read MC1540349 in full; it describes a user sending a reply, not a new identity.

claims.claim: The notice does not describe a new permission for the feature.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams decline incoming call message mobile retention compliance predefined responses customize minimum version permissions. Read MC1540349 in full; no new permission is specified.

claims.claim: The notice does not describe automatic or agent-driven replies.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams mobile decline call message predefined Custom calling policy disable PowerShell licensing price 577176. Read MC1540349 in full; replies follow user selection and no automatic or agent-driven reply is described.

claims.claim: The notice specifies no additional prerequisite beyond the eligible mobile Teams-to-Teams call and associated chat conditions already described.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams decline incoming call message mobile retention compliance predefined responses customize minimum version permissions. Read MC1540349 in full, including Who is affected and Action required; no additional prerequisite is stated.

claims.claim: The notice names no admin role required for this feature.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams decline incoming call message mobile retention compliance predefined responses customize minimum version permissions. Read MC1540349 in full; no admin role is named and it states no admin action is required.

claims.claim: The notice gives three example responses without saying that the list is complete.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams decline incoming call message mobile retention compliance predefined responses customize minimum version permissions. Read MC1540349: it introduces the three responses with 'such as' and gives no exhaustive list.

claims.claim: The notice does not say whether the predefined response list is localised.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams decline incoming call message mobile retention compliance predefined responses customize minimum version permissions. Read MC1540349 in full; it lists example responses but does not discuss localisation.
